City Council Meeting
TORRANCE CITY COUNCIL AGENDA
JUNE 16, 2026
ADJOURNED REGULAR MEETING
5:00 P.M. - CLOSED SESSION
6:30 P.M. - REGULAR BUSINESS BEGINS
in council chamber AT 3031 Torrance Bl.
1.
CALL TO ORDER/ROLL CALL
2.
FLAG SALUTE/NON-SECTARIAN INVOCATION
Flag Salute - Councilmember Mattucci
Invocation - Councilmember Sheikh
3.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS #1 (Limited up to a 30-minute period) This portion of the meeting is reserved for comments on items that are not on the agenda. Under the Ralph M. Brown Act, City Council cannot act on items raised during public comment but may respond briefly to statements made or questions posed; request clarification; or refer the item to staff. Speakers under Orals are limited to either Oral Communications #1 or Oral Communications #2 and no longer than 2 minutes per speaker. Time starts when you step up to the microphone. If presenting handout material to Council, please provide 11 copies to the City Clerk before speaking. Handouts will be distributed while you speak.
